name: @sos-2/tests-live-ux-actions
description: SOS 2.0 Live Actions + Mission UX acceptance suites (Work Order P18-B, lane B of 3). TWO suites, strictly separated (the P17 lane discipline). (1) DETERMINISTIC REFERENCE-MODE SUITE (default; offline; fixed vitest seed 424242): the live action endpoint contract (typed submissions form-encoded and JSON, identity completion for the frozen UI envelopes, idempotent double-submit -> the recorded receipt, typed rejections — AUTHORITY_FIELD_SMUGGLED and ENVELOPE_MALFORMED — never a silent 5xx), authority-at-action-time enforcement through the endpoint's own host (fail-closed on revoked/expired/never-held grants; the executor never invoked on denial), ASK resolution through the merged @sos-2/ask queue (the console's seeded ask, terminal single resolution, typed failures for unknown entries), receipt rendering (the typed receipt view with evidence/rationale links, safe-failure and denied-action UX carrying the authority reason, the replay note), the mount seams (the mission routes render the P17-C live experience over the honest 'unwired' seam; the forms POST to /api/live-mission/actions), and redaction (env NAMES only — never credential values). (2) ENV-GATED REAL INTEGRATION SUITE (RUN_REAL=1, default OFF; strictly separate vitest config): real action submissions over real HTTP against the DEPLOYED preview URL — real body summon through the OpenRouter-backed probe, real promotion/rollback bound to the real Vercel deployment records (exact source_revision_sha), real ASK resolution, idempotent replay over the wire — every step recording HTTP transcripts, receipts, provider states and honest limitations into docs/evidence/production-connectivity/live-ux/actions-mission/. workspace:* dependencies only.

scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck && vitest run && node scripts/run-real-if-env.mjs
scripts.test:real: pnpm run typecheck && vitest run --config vitest.real.config.ts
